stage: 5 of 5: operating point and stability; independent confirmation conditional on accepted data
budget_rationale: Engineering assumption, not a user-approved operational SLA: one FP per 1000 background active account-days; sensitivity profile two FP. Chosen using previous development context before this series. No budget can guarantee unseen FPR.
calibration: All unique inner calibration scores plus finite nextafter(max,+inf) reject-all. Decisions score>=threshold; never split ties. Integer FP budget floor(background_count*rate/1000). Maximize TP, then minimize FP, then prefer higher threshold. No probability calibration or model refit.
infeasible_rule: Retain best budget-respecting threshold, label minimum recall unmet and ineligible; never relax budget, change seed, retrain or choose sensitivity as primary.
controls: Original F1 percentile thresholds unchanged for every config/seed/fold. Reuse nine seed42 checkpoints, exact existing feature preparations. RF rolling isolates model-family comparison with HGB; RF frozen preserves previous best RF policy.
population: Original primary train only; same three outer/inner group folds and exact endpoint/label/window membership from points2-4. No new preprocessing or feature/model hyperparameters.
reporting: All45 config/seed/fold bundles and all135 decision profiles including failures; no best seed
Within-fold PR/ROC AUC; pooled decisions per seed; seed variation separate from fold variation, neither is a confidence interval
Calibration feasibility and frozen outer FP/recall compliance are separate; outer violations do not trigger recalibration
All scenario support/recall, TP/FP/FN and timing; exact reloaded scores/decisions/input membership and source hashes
Compare HGB seed score arrays exactly; deterministic seed repetition is not five independent models or datasets

independent_confirmation.reason: All currently accepted CERT sources were used in development or prior test evaluation. No newly accepted independent CERT holdout exists.
independent_confirmation.action: Do not score old test again. Freeze shortlist/profiles and report development-only result. A later accepted independent CERT source needs source/entity/duplicate audit and a separate protocol before evaluation; CIC network datasets answer a different task.

git_policy: Preserve prior dirty work and frozen artifacts; snapshot code/config/environment in series and incremental patch outside repo. No automatic push or release.
limits: Shortlist chosen using reused development folds in point4. Current seeds test model randomness only, not split independence, temporal prediction, unseen source generalization or production readiness.
